notes.title: Release the Birbs
notes.notes:
You can now race in a new Factory map that is not available in the demo



Full release has it's own scoreboards, so if you played the demo, your time is not carried over to the full game



Remember that this is just an early access release and a lot of stuff is going to change and be added. My plans are big, but I am just a single person developing in my free time, so it will take some time. 

Hope you can enjoy this release and set some nice times in the new map.



If you come across any bugs or problems, let me know on the Steam Community or on Bluesky. 



Thank you all for supporting this endeavour.
